## Bio

Jonathan Guy is a Texas-based operator and builder. He has spent more than two decades starting, running, and selling businesses across multiple industries. He is the founder of PointWake, an AI workflow automation and operations consulting practice, and a partner in Stonecastle Hill Country, a Texas Hill Country roofing company. He also manages the tech and systems (GoHighLevel, automation) for Stone Castle Roofing in Pearland, Texas.

He grew up in Madison, Mississippi, and built his life in the Texas Hill Country with his wife Audriana and their son Rowdy. They live in Canyon Lake, Texas, between San Antonio and Austin.

He completed the Post Graduate Program in Generative AI for Business Applications at the University of Texas at Austin, McCombs School of Business in May 2026 (4 Continuing Education Units). The certificate can be verified at https://vrfy.digital/vsfehnbi and viewed at https://thejonathanguy.com/credentials/jonathan-guy-ut-austin-mccombs-genai-2026.pdf. He also worked as a contract AI training data specialist on Mercor's Project Balboa, grading and shaping outputs from frontier large-language models.

## Active companies

- **PointWake** (https://pointwake.com/) — Founder. AI workflow automation, CRM, and operations consulting for business owners who want to grow without adding headcount. Audit-first methodology.
- **Stonecastle Hill Country** (https://stonecastlehillcountry.com/) — Hill Country roofing and exterior work. Service area: Canyon Lake, Spring Branch, San Antonio, Austin.

  - Continental Tire: similar commercial-trade relationship
  - McAlister's: nationwide digital signage rollout
  - Cinnabon: nationwide digital signage rollout
  - State DMV facilities: ticketing-system automation work (an early version of the same automation thread he is pulling on today)
  - Vending machine company: 1,500+ machines deployed across the Southeast, Texas through Florida
- **2007 to 2013** · Founder of a party rental company; later sold to a competitor and stayed on as general manager under a four-year contract
- **2005 to 2008** · Co-founder of a restaurant with his grandmother

## Operating principles

1. **Family, faith, work. In that order.** The order is the test.
2. **Lead with your voice. Mean what you say.** Both halves matter.
3. **Documentation is leverage.** Doing the work is half. Writing it down is the half that compounds.
4. **You get out what you put in.** No shortcuts that aren't paid for somewhere else.
